sn45.1:1.2: On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling at Savatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anathapiṇḍika’s Park.
sn45.1:1.3: There the Blessed One addressed the bhikkhus thus:
sn45.1:2.1: “Bhikkhus, ignorance is the forerunner in the entry upon unwholesome states, with shamelessness and fearlessness of wrongdoing following along.
sn45.1:2.2: For an unwise person immersed in ignorance, wrong view springs up.
sn45.1:2.3: For one of wrong view, wrong intention springs up.
sn45.1:2.4: For one of wrong intention, wrong speech springs up.
sn45.1:2.5: For one of wrong speech, wrong action springs up.
sn45.1:2.6: For one of wrong action, wrong livelihood springs up.
sn45.1:2.7: For one of wrong livelihood, wrong effort springs up.
sn45.1:2.8: For one of wrong effort, wrong mindfulness springs up.
sn45.1:2.9: For one of wrong mindfulness, wrong concentration springs up.
sn45.1:3.1: “Bhikkhus, true knowledge is the forerunner in the entry upon wholesome states, with a sense of shame and fear of wrongdoing following along.
sn45.1:3.2: For a wise person who has arrived at true knowledge, right view springs up.
sn45.1:3.3: For one of right view, right intention springs up.
sn45.1:3.4: For one of right intention, right speech springs up.
sn45.1:3.5: For one of right speech, right action springs up.
sn45.1:3.6: For one of right action, right livelihood springs up.
sn45.1:3.7: For one of right livelihood, right effort springs up.
sn45.1:3.8: For one of right effort, right mindfulness springs up.
sn45.1:3.9: For one of right mindfulness, right concentration springs up.”
